# Turning Point › Combat Action

> Use this oracle to help inspire an action for an NPC in combat. When you’re not sure what your foe does next, particularly when they have initiative, roll on this table and interpret the result as appropriate to the situation.
>
> Datasworn `oracle_rollable:classic/turning_point/combat_action` · 1d100

- [3] Compel a surrender.
- [3] Coordinate with allies.
- [3] Gather reinforcements.
- [4] Seize something or someone.
- [4] Provoke a reckless response.
- [4] Intimidate or frighten.
- [4] Reveal a surprising truth.
- [4] Shift focus to someone or something else.
- [4] Destroy something, or render it useless.
- [6] Take a decisive action.
- [6] Reinforce defenses.
- [7] Ready an action.
- [8] Use the terrain to gain advantage.
- [8] Leverage the advantage of a weapon or ability.
- [10] Create an opportunity.
- [11] Attack with precision.
- [10] Attack with power.
- [1] Take a completely unexpected action.
